```{=html}
<style>
/* Deliberately page scoped rather than living in styles.css.
   This markup is generated by the script below, and Quarto links styles.css
   without a content hash, so a cached stylesheet can be older than the markup.
   Shipping the layout inside the page makes that impossible: the two can never
   be out of step, and there is still only one place that defines these rules. */

.csf-feed {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  margin: 2.25rem 0 0;
}
@media (min-width: 620px) { .csf-feed { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
@media (min-width: 940px) { .csf-feed { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

.csf-feed__card { min-width: 0; margin: 0; }

/* Block level so the card is a readable stack even with no CSS at all */
.csf-feed__link {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: var(--csf-ink, #2E1F16) !important;
}

/* The padding-top ratio box works in every browser, unlike aspect-ratio, and
   cannot collapse to zero height. overflow:hidden plus an absolutely placed
   image means a picture can never spill over the text under it. */
.csf-feed__thumb {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 0;
  padding-top: 75%;            /* 4:3 */
  margin: 0 0 .9rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--csf-radius, 10px);
  background: rgba(46, 31, 22, .08);
}
.csf-feed__thumb img {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .35s ease;
}
.csf-feed__link:hover .csf-feed__thumb img { opacity: .9; transform: scale(1.02); }

.csf-feed__badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  margin: 0 0 .3rem;
  max-width: none;
  font-size: .74rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--csf-ink-faint, #907E6C);
}
.csf-feed__badge .bi { font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1; }
.csf-feed__badge--youtube   { color: #FF0000; }
.csf-feed__badge--instagram { color: #C13584; }
.csf-feed__badge--tiktok    { color: var(--csf-ink, #2E1F16); }

/* Element qualified so the global h3 margin-top does not push it down */
h3.csf-feed__title {
  margin: 0 0 .3rem;
  font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.22;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  /* feed titles are arbitrary text and must not widen the grid track */
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.csf-feed__link:hover h3.csf-feed__title { color: var(--csf-accent, #C1440E); }

.csf-feed__date {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: none;
  font-size: .82rem;
  color: var(--csf-ink-faint, #907E6C);
}

.csf-feed__cta {
  margin: .6rem 0 0;
  max-width: none;
  font-size: .86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--csf-accent-dk, #9A3409);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .csf-feed__thumb img { transition: none; }
  .csf-feed__link:hover .csf-feed__thumb img { transform: none; }
}
</style>
```

::: {.csf-section}

<h2 class="csf-section__title">Last content</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub" id="csf-feed-status">Loading the newest posts.</p>

<div class="csf-feed" id="csf-feed" aria-busy="true" aria-live="polite"></div>

<noscript>
<div class="csf-empty">
This page builds its list in the browser, so it needs JavaScript. Everything is also
on <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@cuochisenzafuochi">YouTube</a>,
<a href="https://www.instagram.com/cuochi_senza_fuochi/">Instagram</a> and
<a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@cuochi_senza_fuochi">TikTok</a>.
</div>
</noscript>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var LABELS = {
    youtube:   { name: "YouTube",   icon: "bi-youtube",   verb: "Watch on YouTube" },
    instagram: { name: "Instagram", icon: "bi-instagram", verb: "See on Instagram" },
    tiktok:    { name: "TikTok",    icon: "bi-tiktok",    verb: "Watch on TikTok" }
  };

  var feed   = document.getElementById("csf-feed");
  var status = document.getElementById("csf-feed-status");
  if (!feed) return;

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text != null) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  }

  // Built from block level elements (article, figure, h3, p) rather than nested
  // spans, so that with no stylesheet the card degrades to a plain readable
  // stack instead of one run together line of text.
  // Built with the DOM rather than innerHTML: titles come from a feed, so they
  // are untrusted text and must never be parsed as markup.
  function card(item) {
    var meta = LABELS[item.platform] ||
               { name: item.platform, icon: "bi-link-45deg", verb: "Open" };

    var article = el("article", "csf-feed__card");

    var link = el("a", "csf-feed__link");
    link.href = item.url;
    link.rel = "noopener";

    if (item.thumbnail) {
      var frame = el("figure", "csf-feed__thumb");
      var img = document.createElement("img");
      img.src = item.thumbnail;
      img.alt = "";
      img.loading = "lazy";
      img.decoding = "async";
      // A dead thumbnail should remove the frame, not leave a broken icon.
      img.addEventListener("error", function () { frame.remove(); });
      frame.appendChild(img);
      link.appendChild(frame);
    }

    var badge = el("p", "csf-feed__badge csf-feed__badge--" + item.platform);
    var icon = el("i", "bi " + meta.icon);
    icon.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    badge.appendChild(icon);
    badge.appendChild(el("span", null, meta.name));
    link.appendChild(badge);

    link.appendChild(el("h3", "csf-feed__title", item.title || meta.verb));

    if (item.published) {
      var d = new Date(item.published);
      if (!isNaN(d)) {
        var wrap = el("p", "csf-feed__date");
        var t = el("time", null, d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",
          { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" }));
        t.dateTime = d.toISOString();
        wrap.appendChild(t);
        link.appendChild(wrap);
      }
    }

    link.appendChild(el("p", "csf-feed__cta", meta.verb));

    article.appendChild(link);
    return article;
  }

  function fallback(message) {
    feed.replaceChildren();
    feed.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
    if (status) status.textContent = message;

    var box = el("div", "csf-empty");
    box.appendChild(el("p", null, "The list could not be loaded just now."));
    var p = el("p");
    [["https://www.youtube.com/@cuochisenzafuochi", "YouTube"],
     ["https://www.instagram.com/cuochi_senza_fuochi/", "Instagram"],
     ["https://www.tiktok.com/@cuochi_senza_fuochi", "TikTok"]
    ].forEach(function (pair, idx) {
      if (idx) p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" · "));
      var a = el("a", null, pair[1]);
      a.href = pair[0];
      p.appendChild(a);
    });
    box.appendChild(p);
    feed.appendChild(box);
  }

  // Cache busted so a freshly synced file is not hidden behind a stale copy.
  fetch("data/latest-content.json?t=" + Date.now(), { cache: "no-cache" })
    .then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(function (payload) {
      var items = (payload && payload.items) || [];
      if (!items.length) return fallback("Nothing to show yet.");

      var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      items.forEach(function (item) { frag.appendChild(card(item)); });
      feed.replaceChildren(frag);
      feed.removeAttribute("aria-busy");

      if (status) {
        var when = payload.generated ? new Date(payload.generated) : null;
        status.textContent = when && !isNaN(when)
          ? "Everything below is pulled straight from the channel. Last checked " +
            when.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",
              { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" }) + "."
          : "Everything below is pulled straight from the channel.";
      }
    })
    .catch(function (err) {
      if (window.console) console.error("latest content:", err);
      fallback("The list could not be loaded just now.");
    });
})();
</script>
```
